build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c 'if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/app >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Using existing web dev server on :3000"; else bun --cwd ../.. --filter=@blah-chat/web run dev -- --port 3000; fi'

security.csp: default-src 'self' https://blah.chat https://*.blah.chat; script-src 'self' https://blah.chat https://*.blah.chat; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://blah.chat https://*.blah.chat; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' https://blah.chat https://*.blah.chat; connect-src 'self' https://blah.chat https://*.blah.chat wss://blah.chat wss://*.blah.chat
